stories.title: Interstate 80 reopened in Luzerne County
stories.summary: A crash had closed Interstate 80 at the Conyngham Exit in Luzerne County.

stories.title: Lackawanna County extends Code Blue Alert
stories.summary: The Code Blue Alert has been extended and will be in effect from Tuesday night through Thursday morning.

stories.title: Firefighter seriously injured in Pillow Fire Company water tanker rollover
stories.summary: A Pillow Fire Company water tanker overturned Monday evening in Lower Mahanoy Township, leaving driver Leonard Romberger with serious injuries, PSP Troop F says.

stories.title: Three displaced after Scranton apartment fire days before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Days before Thanksgiving, an attic fire spread through a three-unit Scranton apartment building, displacing three residents. No one was hurt; the cause is unknown.

stories.title: Scranton Fire Department mourns passing of active-duty Captain Thomas McColligan
stories.summary: The Scranton Fire Department is mourning the passing of active-duty Captain Thomas McColligan, who served the city for more than 20 years before passing away.

stories.title: A forest of festive fun! TreeFest takes over Bloomsburg
stories.summary: Nearly 100 decorated Christmas trees are bringing holiday cheer to Bloomsburg for the 38th annual TreeFest.

stories.title: Downtown Scranton sees several streets change from one-way to two-way
stories.summary: Residents and businesses are adjusting to the next in a series of changes that were put in place Friday evening as part of the city's Streetscape Project.

stories.title: 50th annual Thanksgiving Community Program expected to feed thousands in Lackawanna County
stories.summary: Volunteers were out in droves Monday in downtown Scranton, getting ready to provide a Thanksgiving dinner for 4,000 people.

stories.title: Old Lycoming Township Fire Co. aims to expand facility with renovation project
stories.summary: Newswatch 16's Mackenzie Aucker shares how an expansion and renovation project at one fire company near Williamsport hopes to address the shortage.

stories.title: Luzerne County rail line sale complete to Reading and Northern Railroad
stories.summary: Luzerne County, in a statement, announced the sale has been completed, saying county residents will now have a better railroad.

stories.title: Middle Smithfield Township's discount card aims to boost local holiday shopping
stories.summary: Middle Smithfield Township's discount card returns, offering deals from over 67 businesses to boost local shopping.

stories.title: Pittston Santa Squad faces rising costs to deliver holiday joy to 1,000 children
stories.summary: The Pittston Santa Squad is dealing with rising costs as it works to bring Christmas joy to 1,000 kids in Luzerne County.
